name: Yungas Guan
rangeDescription: East slope of andes of bolivia to northwestern argentina
description: Large guan with a long tail and red throat wattle. Dark brown overall with extensive white markings on wings.

name: Oaxaca Sparrow
rangeDescription: Arid highlands of southern mexico (central oaxaca)
description: Very local and endemic to interior of Oaxaca, where replaces larger and bulkier Rusty Sparrow (no known range overlap). Favors brushy woodland and edge and oak thickets with adjacent grassy areas.

name: Brown-breasted Kingfisher
rangeDescription: Philippines
description: A fairly large kingfisher of lowland and foothill open country and forest edge. Chocolate brown on the underparts and hood, down to the upper back.

name: Three-wattled Bellbird
rangeDescription: Humid montane forest of nicaragua to western panama
description: Male is unmistakable. Body dark rufous, head and breast gleaming white, with three bare wattles hanging down off the bill.

name: Javan Fulvetta
rangeDescription: Forest of western and central java
description: Unremarkable-looking warm brown songbird. Endemic to Java’s montane and submontane broadleaf forests, where it is a common member of mixed flocks.

name: Cape Teal
rangeDescription: Locally from sudan and ethiopia to namibia and south africa
description: Medium-sized, pale gray duck with a pink bill. In flight, shows a green patch that is surrounded by white.

name: Atiu Swiftlet
rangeDescription: Atiu (southern cook archipelago)
description: A small, mostly brownish swiftlet. Most obvious feature is a pale gray throat contrasting with a darker brownish belly.

name: Palawan Crow
rangeDescription: Southern philippines (balabac, culion, mindoro, and palawan)
description: Large black crow endemic to the western Philippines, from Mindoro west to Palawan. Plumage has an iridescent dark blue sheen when seen up close.

name: Seaside Cinclodes
rangeDescription: Rocky coasts of chile (arica southward to valdivia)
description: Restricted to the rocky coastline of northern and central Chile, where it is rarely seen far from crashing waves; also ranges to adjacent sandy beaches at river mouths. Usually seen as singles or pairs, foraging in the intertidal zone, or singing with wings raised and fluttered from seaside rocks.

name: Mute Swan
rangeDescription: West-central to east-central palearctic region from central europe to southeastern china; introduced widely including to western and southwestern europe, japan, and eastern north america
description: Huge white bird with long neck, reddish-orange bill, and black face. Adults have a black knob on top of the bill.

name: Lined Forest-Falcon
rangeDescription: The guianas and southern venezuela to bolivia and amazonian brazil
description: Fierce-looking raptor of lowland rainforest interior east of the Andes; also ranges up into the foothills in a few areas. Gray with dense barring from throat to breast and an orange face (yellow in younger birds).

name: Mindanao Racquet-tail
rangeDescription: Mountains of mindanao (southern philippines)
description: A medium-sized parrot of montane forest on Mindanao. The two central tail feathers have extended shafts ending in a racket shape.

name: Australasian Gannet
rangeDescription: Breeds islands off southeastern australia including tasmania, and coasts and islands off new zealand
description: Large black-and-white seabird with heavy, pointed bill. Adult white with black flight feathers and central tail feathers, yellow-washed head.

name: Imeri Warbling-Antbird
rangeDescription: East-central colombia to southern venezuela and far northwestern amazonian brazil
description: Small antbird. Males are streaked black above, with a yellow-tinged throat and rusty flanks.

name: Tumbes Sparrow
rangeDescription: Arid littoral of southwestern ecuador and northwestern peru
description: Desert-loving sparrow found only in northwestern Peru and southwestern Ecuador. It has gray underparts, a brown back, a striped head, and a large bill; there is no similar species in its range.

name: Small Sparrowhawk
rangeDescription: Montane forest of sulawesi
description: A small, compact hawk with yellow eyes, a lime-green bill base, and yellow legs. Adult is slate-gray with a vinous breast and whitish belly and thighs.

name: Ecuadorian Thrush
rangeDescription: Coastal western ecuador (esmeraldas) to far northwestern peru (tumbes)
description: A common thrush of clearings and forest edge in most of western Ecuador; also reaches far northwestern Peru. Adult’s tan plumage, yellow bill, and orange eyering are distinct in its range.

name: Fulvous-headed Brushfinch
rangeDescription: Andes of central bolivia from cochabamba southward to northwestern argentina
description: Colorful brushfinch of upper humid montane forest and open humid scrubland in the Andes from NW Argentina to central Bolivia. Superficially similar to Rust-and-yellow Tanager, but note contrasting yellow malar and lores.

name: Italian Sparrow
rangeDescription: Italian peninsula, corsica, sicily, and crete
description: Similar to House and Spanish Sparrows. Males have a brown crown and white cheeks like Spanish Sparrow, but a restricted black throat and upper breast like House Sparrow.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Makira Starling
rangeDescription: Makira (southeastern solomon islands)
description: A rather small, entirely dark starling with a glossy-blue sheen to the head and a more purple sheen elsewhere. Wings and tail are a dull matte earth-brown.
